newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takefuji rises for fourth straight day.
newsitem.headline: Takefuji rises for fourth straight day.

text.p: Shares in Takefuji Corp rose for the fourth consecutive day on Thursday in the over-the-counter market, brokers said.
At 0338 GMT, the consumer financing firm's shares stood at 8,970 yen, up from 8,710 yen on Wednesday.

"Problems stemming from people borrowing from more than one company are attracting attention, but in the case of Takefuji, its earnings are not being influenced," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
"The PER is around the 16 times level and some investors are buying the shares back."
